caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Fluency” illustrates GEMBA-SQM fluency scores for four prompt variants labeled V1 through V4. The category axis is horizontal, showing the four discrete labels in order from left to right as V1, V2, V3, and V4. The value axis is vertical and spans from 97.0 to 100.0 on a linear scale, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.5-point intervals (97.0, 97.5, 98.0, …, 100.0), and horizontal dashed gridlines aligned to these ticks; the axis represents the fluency score on the GEMBA-SQM. There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) vertical bars: V1 is colored blue and reaches approximately 99.15 (also annotated as “99.15” above the bar), V2 is colored orange and reaches about 98.2 (annotated “98.2”), V3 is colored green and reaches about 98.5 (annotated “98.5”), and V4 is colored purple and reaches about 97.7 (annotated “97.7”). The bars are not shown as sorted by value, and no bars appear visually emphasized beyond the numeric value labels placed above each bar.
